name: Bắc Bling
blurb: Hòa Minzy's 2025 folk-meets-hip-hop ode to Bắc Ninh, the fastest V-pop video to 200M views
title: Bắc Bling by Hòa Minzy: Why the Song Went Viral on TikTok
description: Bắc Bling is Hòa Minzy's 2025 song with Xuân Hinh and Tuấn Cry, mixing Bắc Ninh folk with hip-hop. Its quan họ makeover and dance trends swept TikTok.
answer: "Bắc Bling" is a song by Vietnamese singer Hòa Minzy featuring folk performer Xuân Hinh and songwriter Tuấn Cry, released with a music video on 1 March 2025. It mixes northern Vietnamese folk singing with hip-hop and celebrates her home province, Bắc Ninh. On TikTok it set off dance covers and a "transformation" trend of dressing as quan họ folk singers, and its video reached 200 million YouTube views in 81 days, the fastest in V-pop history.

body: There are two trends. In the transformation videos, people start in everyday clothes and, on the beat, switch into the look of a liền chị, a female quan họ singer: a yếm bodice, a beak-shaped headscarf and a wide three-tier conical hat. In the dance videos, groups from children to Gen Z copy routines from the music video. Vietnamese celebrities and beauty queens joined both within days of release.

body.note: Quan họ is the traditional call-and-response folk singing of the Bắc Ninh region, listed by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage. The song also borrows from hát văn, a ritual folk singing style.

head: Date
Event
rows: The music video is shot over three days (13 to 15 January) in Hòa Minzy's home area, with more than 500 people including nearly 300 local residents.
Song and video are released; the video passes 1 million views in about 10 hours.
The quan họ transformation and dance trends spread on TikTok and Facebook in the first week.
The video reaches 100 million YouTube views.
It reaches 200 million views after 81 days, a V-pop record.

body: "Bắc Bling" blends "Bắc Ninh", the northern province the song is about, with "bling", slang for sparkle and shine. So the title means roughly "dazzling Bắc Ninh". The video shows local temples, betel-chewing customs and a scholar's homecoming parade. Some critics said mixing English into the title did not suit such a traditional theme.

ul: No. 1 on the Vietnam Official Chart and No. 2 on Billboard's Vietnam Hot 100.
No. 3 on Spotify's Vietnam Top 50 within 24 hours of release.
Hòa Minzy and her team received a certificate of merit from the chairman of the Bắc Ninh provincial People's Committee for promoting the province.

faq.a: Hòa Minzy, featuring comic and folk performer Xuân Hinh and songwriter Tuấn Cry. Tuấn Cry composed it with Masew, and Masew and DJ Feliks produced it.

faq.q: How does the "Bắc Bling" trend work?
faq.a: Film yourself in normal clothes, then cut on the beat to a full quan họ outfit with headscarf and conical hat, or learn the group dance from the music video and perform it with friends.
It is a pun: "Bắc" from Bắc Ninh province plus "bling" for sparkle, meaning a shining, glamorous Bắc Ninh.
